titleJa: 軟腐病（キャベツ）の掲載例に対応する外観図
altJa: 緑の外葉に囲まれたキャベツの結球部に、褐色に変色して欠けた葉の部分があり、その内側の淡い色の結球部が見えるイラスト。
observationJa: 変色した部分の位置と広がり、葉の欠けや崩れた輪郭、露出した淡い結球部を合わせて見ます。褐色だけで判断せず、周囲の葉や実際の発生状況も確認します。
limitJa: 資料の掲載名に対応する外観の一例です。他の腐敗や傷みと似る場合があり、この図だけで軟腐病と確定できません。軟らかさ、臭い、原因菌は画像から確認できず、防除・農薬の選択や食べられるかどうかの判断にも使いません。

generation.exactPrompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original external symptom-observation illustration for an adult Japanese agriculture learning app. Create one WHOLE cabbage plant head with several surrounding green outer leaves, seen three-quarter from slightly above. Show a broad irregular damaged area on the near side of the head: brown to dark-brown discolored outer leaf tissue with ragged disintegrating missing portions, revealing a pale cream tightly rounded cabbage head underneath. Preserve visible green surrounding outer leaves and enough intact pale curved head to establish cabbage anatomy. The tissue loss is uneven natural deterioration, NOT a clean knife cut, cross-section, peeled demonstration or hole drilled through the head. Gentle botanical educational 2D watercolor/gouache, restrained realistic botanical structure and warm ivory plain background. Entire head and all outer leaf contours visible within comfortable square margins. This is only an external appearance example associated with a textbook caption 'cabbage soft rot'; do not encode any definitive disease diagnosis. Do not depict bacteria, odor lines, softness by touch, medical icons, insects, mold fuzz, spores, ooze droplets, tools, pesticide, treatment, hands, food preparation, edible-quality badges, arrows, labels, text, numbers, logos, frame or watermark. No comparison panel, no reference/input images, no copying a source photo composition. Brown color alone must not be the only visual feature: localized outer tissue loss and exposed pale head are essential.

sourceFeatureBoundary.genericIllustrationDetailsJa: 全体の配置、葉脈、損傷の輪郭は独自の図示です。色・組織欠損・部位の観察例であり、軟らかさや臭い、原因菌、症状の進行段階を示していません。
